description: For a well-ordered linear order and fixed rules, any two partial recursive solutions agree on the intersection of their domains.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.partial_recursive_solutions_agree.{u, v} {α : Type u} {S : Type v} [LinearOrder α]
  [WellFoundedLT α] (Φ : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.RecursionRule α S) (h k : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartialRecursiveSolution Φ)
  (a : α) (ha : a ∈ h.domain) (hk : a ∈ k.domain) : h.value ⟨a, ha⟩ = k.value ⟨a, hk⟩
